description: Engine setup of map4_s05 (Central SH Otherworld - Floatstinger boss), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type SPU, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: Floatstinger). "effect_draws" lists the effect slot drawers the map has; an effect slot of any other kind is not drawn. Here: acid (acid spit and its splashes) and light_glow (glowing light sprites). A mod changes it with its own maps/map4_s05/overlay.json.
